description: The file contains source code implementing a bitset compression and iteration mechanism, specifically related to the 'EWAH' bitmap compression technique. It includes functions for iterating over compressed bitmaps, managing literal and run-length encoded words, and discharging bits into an output bitmap.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word in the compressed bitmap, updating the iterator's state with metadata from the current word.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes a run-length word iterator from a given EWAH bitmap, setting up internal pointers and reading the first word.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Skips the first 'x' words in the compressed bitmap, adjusting the iterator's internal state accordingly.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Decompresses and copies up to 'max' words from the compressed bitmap into an output bitmap, with optional negation.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
